definitions.explanation: The process of separating grain (especially rice) from the plant stalks and husks after harvesting.

examples.japanese: {稲|いね}を{刈|か}り{取|と}った{後|あと}、{脱穀|だっこく}する。
examples.english: After harvesting the rice plants, we thresh them.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{手作業|てさぎょう}で{脱穀|だっこく}していた。
examples.english: In the old days, threshing was done by hand.

examples.japanese: コンバインは{刈|か}り{取|と}りと{脱穀|だっこく}を{同時|どうじ}に{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: A combine harvester performs both cutting and threshing at the same time.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{脱|だつ} (remove) + {穀|こく} (grain)

RICE PRODUCTION PROCESS:
1. {田植|たう}え (rice planting)
2. {稲刈|いねか}り (harvesting)
3. {脱穀|だっこく} (threshing)
4. {乾燥|かんそう} (drying)
5. {籾摺|もみす}り (hulling)
6. {精米|せいまい} (polishing)

TRADITIONAL TOOLS:
・{千歯|せんば}こき (traditional threshing comb with many teeth)
・{足踏|あしぶ}み{脱穀機|だっこくき} (foot-powered threshing machine)

MODERN EQUIPMENT:
・{脱穀機|だっこくき} (threshing machine)
・コンバイン (combine harvester - cuts and threshes)
